resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy for Title Transfer (certificate of inspection, sale or transfer)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Avon-by-the-Sea Fire Bureau / housing inspection (Code Enforcement)
resale_co.lead_time: Apply at least 14 days ahead; requests under 14 days may be charged an additional fee.
requirements: Housing inspection by the Fire Bureau; no Certificate of Occupancy is issued while any violations remain
Both the Certificate of Occupancy and Transfer of Title application and the smoke detector / carbon monoxide alarm compliance application must be submitted
Smoke detectors (10-year sealed if not hard wired) and carbon monoxide detector
Outside conditions such as porches, landings, sidewalks and driveway may need repair before the certificate is issued

fees.label: Certificate of inspection, sale or transfer, one family dwelling (Code 88-4)
Certificate of inspection, sale or transfer, multifamily or apartments (Code 88-4)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Pick up the Certificate of Occupancy & Transfer of Title application and the smoke/CO compliance application at the Borough Municipal Building, 301 Main Street (8:30 am to 4:30 pm), fill out both, and drop off or mail them with a check for the right amount; the inspection is then scheduled. Questions: firebureau@avonbytheseanj.com.
resale_co.contact_title: House inspection (Fire Bureau); listed as Fire Official Paul A Murphy, Jr in the state directory

evidence.quote: Housing License - Title Transfer - Yearly Rentals - Winter/Summer Rentals
Certificate of Occupancy Inspection, Sales and Rentals:
A period of 14 days is a minimum that will be required for this office, due to the limited scheduled office hours.

No housing unit will be issued a Certificate of Occupancy while any outstanding violations exist, and no housing unit will be allowed to be occupied prior to the issuance of a Certificate of Occupancy.
Note: both forms below must be submitted before a C of O can be issued.
The fees for certificates of inspection shall be as follows:

evidence.quote: LEAID: 1305-001 Avon By The Sea Boro SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name: Avon By the Sea Boro Enf Auth. Fire Dept Addr: 301 Main St Avon NJ 07717 Fire Official Paul A Murphy, Jr Phone (732) 502-4518

resale_co.notes: The Borough's Fire Bureau/Rental & Resale CO page covers Title Transfer and says both the C of O / Transfer of Title application and the smoke/CO application must be submitted before a C of O is issued. Fees come from Borough Code 88-4 (added 1997): sale or transfer $75.00 one family, $90.00 multifamily or apartments, $25.00 reinspection; the code text was read through the ecode360 print view. The page's link to the combined application form ('CO Form.pdf') returned an error when checked, so application_url is blank. The page lists no phone; (732) 502-4518 is the Fire Bureau number from the state fire directory. Rental certificates, landlord registration and the business/rental insurance registration are rental-only.

requirements: Smoke detectors required; 10-year sealed detectors if not hard wired

Fire extinguisher on all sales and rentals: 5 to 10 lb ABC, on the manufacturer's bracket, within 10 feet of the kitchen, top no higher than 5 feet, near an exit path, with the manual and instructions visible (page still lists it)

authorities.name: Avon-by-the-Sea Fire Bureau (Borough fire official)
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on business days before the change of occupant. The office asks for at least 14 days for inspections.

fees.quote: 1. Requests for a CSDCMAC received more than 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $ 45.00

fees.label: Four to 10 business days before
fees.quote: 2. Requests for a CSDCMAC received four to 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $ 90.00

fees.label: Fewer than four business days before
fees.quote: 3. Requests for a CSDCMAC received fewer than four business days prior to the change of occupant: $ 161.00

fees.label: Smoke detector and CO inspection, R-3 dwellings, more than 10 business days (Code 100-8C)
fees.quote: Applications received more than 10 business days prior to change of occupant: $45.

fees.quote: Applications received four to 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $90.

fees.label: Fewer than four business days (Code 100-8C)
fees.quote: Applications received fewer than four business days prior to the change of occupant: $161.

authorities.how_to_apply: Submit the Certificate of Smoke Detector Carbon Monoxide Alarm Compliance application together with the C of O / Transfer of Title application at the Borough Municipal Building, 301 Main Street, with a check. Questions: firebureau@avonbytheseanj.com.

evidence.quote: Also, the sale or rental of any housing unit without a Smoke Defector or Carbon Monoxide Compliance Certificate is punishable by a $500.00 fine, according to the NJ Uniform Fire Code.
10 Year sealed detectors are required if not hard wired.

fire_cert.notes: The Borough's Fire Bureau page and Borough Code 100-8C both list the state tiers $45 / $90 / $161. Code 100-9B also lists 'Smoke Detector Application and Certificate. $45.' The page still lists a fire extinguisher requirement for all sales and rentals; the state dropped it from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19), so confirm with the Fire Bureau.
